data.name: ADHD Simulator
data.detailed_description:
The alarm rings. Today’s the day.
You get up, make coffee, feed the dog, water the plants, and finally sit down to work…

But then reality begins. The phone vibrates, the dog barks, something breaks, the neighbor’s at the door.
And your thoughts? They’re already somewhere else.

Just like everyone else, you have to pay bills, earn money, take care of your house, and do all those everyday routines – eat, drink, water the plants, take care of the dog, clean up, wash the dishes...
But there’s one big BUT.

You’ve only recently discovered that you have ADHD.
For years, you thought you were just lazy, unorganized, or incapable of focusing.
But it turns out those four little letters are what shape the quality of your life and your relationships.

You might think it’s nothing. That everyone has it.
Then it shouldn’t be that hard for you to water a few plants, walk the dog, or just sit down and write one simple email… right?

Gameplay and Features

  • Experience a day in the life of a person with ADHD — doing normal things that never go according to plan.

  • Monitor your stats like focus, serotonin, mood, hunger, thirst, energy, and bladder needs.

  • React to random events — a ringing neighbor, a broken sink, or food exploding in the microwave.

  • Listen to your inner monologue, which changes based on your mental state.

  • Discover multiple endings of the day — from total chaos to peaceful focus.

  • Realistic environments — a detailed house, garden, street, and neighbors, all with dynamic sound and weather systems.
